title: Accounts Payable Controller
description:
We are recruiting an Accounts Payable Controller for a permanent position within a busy finance team in Slough. The role offers a salary of £35,000-£38,000, a 37-hour Monday-to-Friday working week and the option to work from home two days per week after successful completion of probation.

The opportunity

This is a hands-on position with responsibility across the full supplier-payment cycle. You will help maintain accurate records, keep payments moving to schedule and provide a reliable point of contact for suppliers and colleagues across the business.

What you will be doing
- Process a high volume of purchase-order and non-purchase-order invoices, checking coding, approvals and ERP postings.
- Investigate supplier queries and resolve pricing, quantity and documentation differences with operational teams.
- Reconcile supplier statements and review outstanding goods-received-not-invoiced items.
- Prepare payment runs, upload banking files and record payments in line with established controls.
- Maintain supplier records, verify bank information and support appropriate onboarding checks.
- Assist with month-end activity and provide accurate information for audit requests.
- Contribute ideas and user feedback for process improvements, system upgrades and greater standardisation.

About you

You will have practical accounts payable or invoice-to-pay experience gained in a high-volume environment. A sound understanding of purchase-order matching, supplier reconciliations, GRNI and payment runs is important. You should also be confident using Excel, including pivot tables and lookup functions, and able to organise a demanding workload with accuracy and limited supervision.

This opportunity would suit a collaborative and detail-focused AP professional who enjoys resolving problems and improving the way finance processes operate.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Exciting Opportunity: Bookkeeper

Cashtrak Full-Time Flexible Hours Predominantly Home-Based

Are You Looking for a Role That Works Around You?

We're an established, award-winning bookkeeping practice looking for a talented and motivated Bookkeeper to join our friendly, close-knit team. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow with a practice that genuinely invests in its people - offering flexible working around core hours, real development opportunities, and a team culture built on integrity, trust, and a shared love of getting things right.

The Role

You'll be taking ownership of a portfolio of bookkeeping clients, keeping monthly and quarterly records in order, preparing VAT returns, and ensuring clients' financial records are accurate and up to date. You'll work closely with the wider team, attending regular one-to-ones and team meetings, and following our well-established practice procedures.

Key Responsibilities Include:
- Monthly and quarterly bookkeeping for a varied client portfolio
- Preparation and submission of VAT returns
- Journals and bookkeeping adjustments as required
- Communicating directly with clients in a professional and helpful manner
- Working within our practice management systems and document capture software
- Responding to client queries in a professional and timely manner
- Assisting with year-end preparation and supporting colleagues and/ or accountants as required

What We're Looking For

Qualifications & Experience
- Minimum ICB Level 2 or AAT Level 2 qualification (or equivalent)
- At least 6 months' experience working within the bookkeeping or accounting industry
- Competent and confident with Xero - our primary software
- Comfortable with Microsoft Office applications
- Experience with QuickBooks would make you a strong candidate

The Kind of Person You Are

We care as much about who you are as what you know. Our ideal candidate is someone who:
- Has exceptional attention to detail and takes real pride in accuracy
- Brings honesty, integrity, and transparency to everything they do
- Loves learning and stays curious about changes in legislation and software
- Has a great attitude towards client service and enjoys building relationships
- Thrives on problem solving and isn't fazed by a challenge
- Is happy to follow processes - and even help improve them

Working Arrangements
- Full-time contract with core hours agreed to fall within the working week
- Predominantly home-based with flexibility to suit your life
- During the initial phase (up to 6 months), you will be expected to work from our office 2-3 times per week while you become familiar with our clients, systems, and the way we work - we find in-person onboarding makes a real difference
- Must be able to drive and be based within Buckinghamshire or Berkshire.

Salary & Benefits
- £26,000 - £30,000 per annum, depending on experience
- Flexible working hours
- Predominantly home-based role - a real advantage over many comparable positions
- Genuine opportunities for training, development, and progression within the practice
- Supportive, experienced team around you from day one
- Regular team meetings and one-to-ones to help you grow and feel connected

How to Apply

We'd love to hear from you. Please send your CV and a brief covering letter telling us a little about yourself and why this role appeals to you.

Closing date for applications: 9th October 2026 Interviews will be completed by 23rd October 2026.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a high volume of suitable applications, so we encourage you to apply promptly

Cashtrak is an equal opportunities employer.
